name: dsh-limit-guard
description: Stops the agent before usage limits run out and makes it write a handoff file (context window, Wiolett, ChatGPT/Codex subscription), then holds automatic work (goal rounds, retries) until the window resets. Settings page with remaining limits, pace and per-task spend; one-click handoff-summary button.

summary.en: Stops work before limits run out, writes a handoff file and holds goal rounds until the reset. Settings page with limits left and per-task spend.
summary.ru: Останавливает работу до исчерпания лимитов, пишет файл передачи дел и держит goal до сброса. Страница в настройках: остаток лимитов и расход по задачам.
